asset.name: Celestia

score_rationales.supply: Official docs fix genesis at 1B TIA with no uncapped tail; post–v6 (CIP-41, Nov 2025) headline inflation is about 2.5% annually and steps down 6.7% per year toward a 1.5% floor—materially better than launch-era 8% but still ongoing issuance. On-chain staking dashboards report roughly 43–44% of minted supply bonded, which materially reduces liquid float versus unstaked holdings. Genesis allocates only 20% to public allocation versus ~54% combined early backers plus core/R&D-style buckets with staged unlocks through year 4 (R&E), which keeps insider and ecosystem overhang as a structural drag; public exchange reserve trends were not used here because no comparable snapshot series was provided.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Evidence includes large cumulative rollup data posted to Celestia (third-party analyses citing 160+ GB total and multi‑GB daily averages), namespace-level activity such as Eclipse-scale deployments (~58,486 MB across millions of blobs per public DA leaderboards), post‑Matcha mainnet stress/load tests reporting on the order of ~100 GiB/day sustained throughput with 99.97% blob inclusion, and reported multifold growth in blob fee revenue since late 2024—indicating real modular DA adoption but with notable rollup concentration and still-early absolute fee scale versus Ethereum blobs and competing DA stacks.
